description: {"use_when":{"en":"Use when you have a Catholic or Bible question and do not know which tool fits: one entry point that returns the published texts with their source.","es":"Úsala cuando tengas una pregunta católica o bíblica y no sepas qué herramienta usar: una sola puerta que devuelve los textos publicados con su fuente."},"what":{"en":"Ask a question in plain language (es/en/it) and get the published texts that answer it: the tool used, its arguments and its full JSON result (up to 3), e.g. \"readings of today\", \"JHN 3:16\", \"what are the capital sins?\". Keyword routing over this church's published texts: no text is generated, no language model is used, and the question is neither echoed back nor stored by this code. Every answer, and every error produced while handling an ask call (arguments, protocol headers, internal errors), carries care_reminder (transport rejections before the request is read, such as 413, 415, a malformed JSON-RPC envelope or the 429 rate limit, do not) (a short reminder to encourage human help if the person says they do not want to live); care_note is added when the question shows a risk. It does not guess: if the intent is not recognised it returns understood:false and tool_catalog (every tool with its parameters and an example) so the calling agent chooses; it searches the Bible only when asked («search…», «what does the Bible say about…»).","es":"Pregunta en lenguaje normal y recibe los textos publicados que la responden, con la herramienta usada; no genera texto, no devuelve ni guarda la pregunta; si no reconoce la intención no adivina: devuelve understood:false y tool_catalog."}}
